ReadLog.subtitle: Track every book you read
ReadLog.desc:
Most reading apps are a catalog, a feed, or both. ReadLog is the opposite: a quiet, private place for your reading — the books, the quotes you want to keep, and a recap you'll actually want to look back on.

Save the lines worth keeping
Type a quote or scan it straight from the page with your camera. Tag it to the book, add the page, mark a favorite. Your highlights live in one searchable journal — not locked inside an e-reader.

See your reading add up
Books finished, pages read, your reading pace and streak, top genres, books by month. Set a yearly goal and watch it fill. Every number reflects only what you've logged.

Make a Reading Wrapped — anytime
Turn any month, year, or single book into a beautiful recap card and share it in a tap. Not once a year — whenever you finish something you're proud of.

Your library, your shelf
Track every book through to-read, reading, finished, did not finish, and reference. Log sessions as you go and see each book fill up.

Private by design
No account. No AI. Not tied to Amazon or any store. Everything stays on your device — nothing is uploaded, synced to us, or sold.

Free — no account needed
Unlimited books and shelf, reading sessions, ratings, basic stats, and a yearly recap card.

Premium — 7-day free trial, then $6.99/month or $39.99/year
- Reading Wrapped for any month, quarter, year, or single book, plus extra card styles
- Unlimited quotes and camera quote scanning
- Reading goals and full stats & trends
- Reading-log PDF export and full library backup
- Cancel anytime from your Apple ID settings

ReadLog is a personal reading journal. You enter your own books, quotes, and sessions; any stats or recaps it shows reflect only what you've logged. Your data is stored on your device and is not uploaded or shared.
